'''Drizan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], Captain Drizan was stationed in the private shipyard [[Zone Twelve/Legends|Zone Twelve]] when the Barsen'thor and the crew landed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to search for [[Nadia Grell|Nadia]] and triangulate the escape pod which was used in emergency broadcasts during the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TOR" />
